```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(lme4) 

# Ensure variables are factors and drop rows missing ED50 or site data
df_modeling <- annot_master %>%
  mutate(across(c(starts_with("K_"), site), as.factor)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), !is.na(site))

k_cols <- paste0("K_", 2:15)

# Loop through and compute AIC using lmer()
aic_mixed_all <- map_df(k_cols, function(k_name) {
  
  # Fit Mixed Model: ED50 ~ Cluster fixed effect + Site/Run random effect
  # REML = FALSE is CRITICAL here because we are comparing models with different fixed effects
  model <- lmer(as.formula(paste("ED50 ~", k_name, "+ (1 | site)")), 
                data = df_modeling, 
                REML = FALSE)
  
  data.frame(
    Model = k_name,
    AIC = AIC(model)
  )
})

# Arrange from lowest AIC (best) to highest
aic_mixed_all <- aic_mixed_all %>% arrange(AIC)
print("--- Full Dataset Mixed Model Comparisons ---")
print(aic_mixed_all)

k12_m <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_12 + (1 | site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k13_m <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_13 + (1 | site), data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)
k2_m  <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_2 + (1 | site),  data = df_modeling, REML = FALSE)

# 2. Run the comparative ANOVA (Likelihood Ratio Test)
anova(k2_m, k12_m, k13_m)



library(emmeans)

# 1. Calculate the estimated marginal means for each cluster group
k12_means <- emmeans(k12_m, specs = ~ K_12)

# 2. Run the pairwise post-hoc comparisons with Tukey adjustment
k12_posthoc <- pairs(k12_means, adjust = "tukey")

# 3. View the results
# (Optional: filter for only statistically significant differences)
k12_posthoc_df <- as.data.frame(k12_posthoc)

significant_differences <- k12_posthoc_df %>% 
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

print(significant_differences)
plot(k12_means, comparisons = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#because we are getting singular it boundary error, exploring dropping some groups that have zero site variances
table(df_modeling$K_12)

# Filter out clusters that have fewer than 5 observations globally
df_filtered_clusters <- df_modeling %>%
  group_by(K_12) %>%
  filter(n() >= 8) %>% #below causes signular fit boundary error
  ungroup()

# Re-run the mixed model on the filtered data
k12_m_clean <- lmer(ED50 ~ K_12 + (1 | site), data = df_filtered_clusters, REML = FALSE)
summary(k12_m_clean)
anova(k12_m_clean)
# 1. Calculate the estimated marginal means for each cluster group
k12_clean_means <- emmeans(k12_m_clean, specs = ~ K_12)

# 2. Run the pairwise post-hoc comparisons with Tukey adjustment
k12_clean_posthoc <- pairs(k12_clean_means, adjust = "tukey")

# 3. View the results
# (Optional: filter for only statistically significant differences)
k12_clean_posthoc_df <- as.data.frame(k12_clean_posthoc)
significant_differences <- k12_clean_posthoc_df %>% 
  filter(p.value < 0.05)
print(significant_differences)
plot(k12_means, comparisons = TRUE)
#check boxplot
#plot ED50 by cluster assignment, here K=12

# --- 2. Clean Data & Reorder Factor Levels ---
df_sorted <- df_filtered_clusters %>%
  filter(ED50 < 45) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Force K_12 to follow your specific sequence on the x-axis
    K_12_sorted = factor(as.character(K_12), levels = custom_order),
    species_color = toupper(trimws(species))
  ) %>%
  # Drop any rows that don't match your custom level list (if any exist)
  filter(!is.na(K_12_sorted))

# --- 3. Build the Single Unfaceted Plot ---
ggplot(df_sorted, aes(x = K_12_sorted, y = ED50)) +
  # One clean boxplot per cluster step along your custom x-axis order
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = "grey98") +
  
  # Scatter individual dots colored by species
  geom_jitter(aes(color = species_color, shape = site), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(
   # title = "ED50 Phenotypes Ordered by Custom Cluster Sequence",
    x = "K_12 Cluster Assignment",
    y = expression(ED[50]*" Score"),
    color = "Species"
    
  )
```
